rows.text: O.N. 28(E) of 9 August 1999 amends Table I of notification No. 56/99/Jud.III of 30 July 1999 so that entry 6 (Janata Dal; symbol Chakra (Wheel); 7, Jantar Mantar Road, New Delhi-110001) carries the note 'The name of the party and the symbol under dispute - symbol not to be allotted until further orders.'

locator.section: O.N. 28(E), paragraph 1 (entry 6, begun on PDF page 2)

rows.text: The same amendment adds entry 6(A), Janata Dal (Secular), symbol Kisan Driving Tractor, at 5, Safdarjung Lane, New Delhi-110001, and entry 6(B), Janata Dal (United), symbol Arrow, at 7, Jantar Mantar Road, New Delhi-110001.
